## Discussion by @sierkov

## Comment by @sierkov

I’ve found the root cause. In this trace, accumulation terminates due to **out-of-gas**. I misapplied the transformation from (A.44):
```
u = ϱ − max(ϱ′, 0)
```
as:
```
u = ϱ − ϱ′
```
Per (A.1), out-of-gas occurs when ϱ′ < 0. Here ϱ′ = −1, so the correct computation is:
```
u = ϱ − max(−1, 0) = ϱ − 0 = ϱ
```
Whereas my code did:
```
u = ϱ − (−1) = ϱ + 1
```
—which inflates u by 1 and explains the one-unit gas discrepancy from the expected value.
